cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the WordPress Developer position. With hands-on experience building and maintaining WordPress sites at Episto and on my own project, mirook.com, I've developed a practical skill set that aligns closely with your requirements.

At Episto, I build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme. I handle content uploads, page updates, and on-page SEO, ensuring sites are responsive and search-friendly. On mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site from the ground up, implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), and ran iterative technical SEO audits that measurably improved the site's search-health score. This project also involved social media integration and a focus on speed and security.

My technical foundation includes HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and PHP, along with front-end development experience from ViviDoctor, where I optimized features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. I'm comfortable troubleshooting issues, implementing updates and backups, and ensuring cross-browser compatibility. I also use tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to guide optimization decisions.

I'm a collaborative problem-solver with a keen eye for detail. I enjoy turning design concepts into functional, high-performing websites and staying current with WordPress best practices. I'm eager to contribute to your team and help deliver outstanding user experiences for your clients.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
